key_highlights: ASX logged its third consecutive weekly gain led by broad-based rallies across mining and technology shares.
Surging unemployment to a 5-year high in NSW and nationally dampens RBA rate hike prospects and weakens AUD/USD.
Emerging headwinds in Sydney residential auctions and property debt raise caution for major bank credit portfolios.
Junior and mid-tier gold and critical mineral producers benefit from safe-haven demand and fast-tracked production.

sectors.trend: Bullish momentum in gold exploration and rare earths, offset by geopolitical trade scrutiny over Chinese exports.
sectors.implications: Accelerating domestic gold and critical minerals projects provides defensive upside; bulk miners face mixed export demand.

sectors.trend: Margin pressure mounting as softening labor data tempers cash rate hike expectations and auction clearances weaken.
sectors.implications: Major banks face net interest margin contraction and rising credit risk provisioning if housing market stress intensifies.

sectors.trend: Outperforming with strong weekly momentum alongside global risk appetite and easing domestic yield pressures.
sectors.implications: Lower terminal rate expectations support high-multiple ASX tech valuations, though balance sheet resilience remains key.

sectors.trend: Structural supply tightness in domestic gas supplies clashing with legal and net-zero policy hurdles.
sectors.implications: East Coast gas shortages present near-term price support for domestic producers amid regulatory headwinds.

sectors.trend: Selective consumer resilience tempered by elevated cost-of-living burdens and corporate governance scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Discretionary retailers face margin scrutiny; automotive sector disruption deepens as EV adoption reshapes vehicle residual values.

key_themes: RBA Policy Pivot: Rising unemployment shifting rate outlook from tightening to dovish hold or forward cuts.
Currency Devaluation: Soft macro data depressing AUD/USD, improving competitiveness for unhedged commodity exporters.
Housing Divergence: Suburb-level mortgage vs. rent discrepancies emerging against broader auction market softening.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate out of highly cyclical consumer discretionary into defensive income and USD-earning resource names.
Underweight high-LVR mortgage-exposed retail banks; favour diversified wealth and institutional lenders.
Focus on domestic critical mineral supply chains and gold producers with ex-China offtake agreements.
Maintain exposure to low-cost domestic gas infrastructure and upstream operators positioned for spot market upside.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold and Critical Minerals Developers
opportunities.rationale: Strong commodity pricing, near-term production milestones, and weaker AUD bolster operating cash margins.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate Quality Growth and Technology Leaders
opportunities.rationale: Easing bond yield pressure following high unemployment print provides valuation support for structural growers.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Rate-Sensitive Major Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Slowing credit expansion, rising arrears risk from housing softness, and compressed net interest margins.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Broader Index Downside via ASX Index Options or Cash
defensive_moves.rationale: Geopolitical trade risks and weakening consumer fundamentals threaten sustainability of third-week equity rally.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound trading for ^AXJO (1–3 months) as resource and tech momentum balances macro softening and property cooling.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive 6–12 month outlook contingent on RBA easing cycle commencement and stabilization in key export markets.
key_catalysts: Upcoming RBA Board monetary policy meeting and cash rate decision
Australian quarterly CPI and Wage Price Index releases
China GDP and industrial production data regarding export policy trajectory
Domestic East Coast gas regulatory and supply policy determinations

Iron ore 62% Fe CFR Qingdao and spot gold (AUD/oz) prices
ASX bank net interest margin and bad debt provisioning guidance
